title: Union with Christ in Salvation
definition: Union with Christ in Salvation is the believer's spiritual connection to Jesus by which His life, death, resurrection, righteousness, and inheritance become theirs by grace.
summary: Believers are saved in Christ and share in His life by faith.
christFocus: Jesus is not only the giver of salvation but the living Savior to whom believers are joined forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Union with Christ in Salvation helps explain how God saves sinners through Jesus Christ rather than through human merit, religious performance, or self-rescue. This doctrine shows that salvation is personal, covenantal, and centered on the finished work of Christ.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can understand the grace they have received and proclaim the Gospel with clarity. It guards the Church from confusion by keeping sin, grace, faith, repentance, righteousness, forgiveness, and eternal hope in their biblical order.

The heart of this doctrine is believers are saved in christ and share in his life by faith.. It should lead to worship, assurance, humility, holiness, and a deeper confidence in the Savior who saves completely.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because people easily drift toward either despair or self-righteousness. Union with Christ in Salvation reminds believers that salvation belongs to the Lord, rests in Christ, and produces real transformation without turning grace into license or obedience into a way to earn acceptance with God.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility and examine whether your hope is resting in Christ. Let union with christ in salvation shape your prayers, your witness, your repentance, and your daily confidence that Jesus is able to save and keep all who come to God through Him.
